entry.title: NAXOS
entry.text: NAXOS, or NAXIA, a considerable town, and capital of the lake of Naoxe, opposite the lake of Peru, with a cudal and two ambishaby’s seen, the one check out the other Latin. The greater part of the inhabitants are Greek, Lilly, 25.13. E., Lae 37.6.N.
